solution: There is a pair of escalators connecting the campus. I must take the escalator to get to the campus since there are no staircases nearby. One of these escalators is often under maintenance. When this happens, the other escalator will be paused so that people can use it as a staircase to enter and exit the campus.
canonical_facts: A pair of escalators provides access to campus where there are no nearby ordinary stairs
One escalator is often under maintenance
During that maintenance the OTHER escalator is stopped so people can walk on its steps in both directions
